sentences.text: The known fossil remains consist of parts of the pelvis and four tail vertebrae forming the base of the tail.
The genus was established by Peecook and colleagues in 2013 based on a single holotype fossil specimen containing hip bones and tail vertebrae.
Fossils were collected in 2009 from the upper Ntawere Formation, dating to the Anisian stage of the Middle Triassic.
Lutungutali belongs to the family Silesauridae, a group of archosaurs very closely related to Dinosauria, and is classified within the unranked order Ornithodira.
The type species of the genus is Lutungutali sitwensis.
The closest silesaurid relative is Asilisaurus from the Anisian-age Manda Formation of Tanzania.
Researchers suggest that the presence of derived avemetatarsalians like Lutungutali in the Middle Triassic indicates a rapid diversification of this group earlier than previously thought.
